name: Are smart light switches good for accessibility, and what features do they offer?

mainEntity.name: Are smart light switches good for accessibility, and what features do they offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, smart light switches are excellent for accessibility. They offer control via smartphone apps, voice commands through smart assistants, or even automated scheduling. This eliminates the need to physically interact with a switch, which is beneficial for individuals with limited mobility or dexterity. Some systems also include motion sensors to automatically turn lights on and off, further enhancing convenience and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smart switches offer accessibility via apps, voice control, or automation, eliminating the need for physical interaction and enhancing convenience.
